{{Top|leg}}
'''Identiplates''' were installed aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to record the ownership history of the vessel. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]{{'s}} identiplate was removed long before it came under the ownership of either [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] or [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], which made it an asset for [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]]. Because the identiplate was removed, the ship's previous owners were largely unknown.<ref name="SWTJPT">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Planet Tatooine]]''</ref>
